verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a separate test environment for in-person payments: a test Customer Area, a test card for simulating brands, CVMs and declines, and a testing system to validate the integration before switching to live transactions. Adyen itself calls it a 'basic' testing system, and the docs never explicitly state isolation from production data. missing for 10: explicit documentation that test and live environments and data are isolated, test-environment coverage beyond basic transaction scenarios (such as a terminal simulator or API-level sandbox endpoints), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can use this system to ensure your test integration is working as expected, before you switch to an integration that can make live transactions.
We provide a basic testing system to simulate transaction scenarios and functionalities.
You can order an Adyen test card from your test Customer Area
Using the Adyen test card, you can: Test different card brands. Test different CVMs. Test declined payments.
